title: Weekend Plans
summary: Ama and Carlos talk about what they like to do at the weekend and plan a day out together.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama and Carlos at a small table with a calendar and two cups, a bright window behind them, no text

sentences.text: Hello, everybody! Today Carlos and I talk about the weekend.
Hi, Ama. I love weekends because I can sleep late.
Really? I get up early and go for a walk.
The streets are quiet, and the air is fresh.
That sounds nice, but I prefer my bed.
What do you do after you get up?
I cook a big breakfast and read a magazine.
That is a good way to relax.

quiz.q: Why does Ama get up early?
quiz.explain: She says the streets are quiet, and the air is fresh.

quiz.q: What does Carlos like at the weekend?
quiz.explain: Carlos says he can sleep late.

quiz.q: What does Carlos do after he gets up?
quiz.explain: He cooks a big breakfast and reads a magazine.

sentences.text: Ama, are you free next Saturday?
I think so. Do you have a plan?
Yes! There is a small festival in the old town.
Great idea. Is there any music?
Yes, and there are many food stalls too.
Then let us go together. I will ask my sister to come.
Perfect. We can meet at the station at ten.
I will bring my camera and take some photos.

quiz.explain: There is a small festival in the old town.

I will bring my camera and take some photos.
